from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tempfile
import time

import libtmux
from libtmux.constants import PaneDirection

directory = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="libtmux-py-home-"))
socket = directory / "tmux.sock"
server = libtmux.Server(socket_path=socket, config_file="/dev/null")

try:
    session = server.new_session(session_name="demo")

    # Lay out the session: name its window, split it, add a second window.
    editor = session.active_window
    editor.rename_window("editor")
    left = editor.active_pane
    assert left is not None
    right = left.split(direction=PaneDirection.Right, shell="sh")
    logs = session.new_window(window_name="logs")

    # Type a command into the new pane and wait for what it prints.
    right.send_keys("printf 'hello from %s\\n' tmux", enter=True)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
    while "hello from tmux" not in right.capture_pane():
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            raise TimeoutError("The pane did not print hello from tmux")
        time.sleep(0.02)

    # Move the focus an attached client sees: the pane, then the window.
    right.select()
    logs.select()

    # Walk the objects: down from the server, then up from one pane.
    sessions = server.sessions
    for each in sessions:
        print("session", each.session_name)
        windows = each.windows
        for window in windows:
            panes = window.panes
            ids = " ".join(pane.pane_id for pane in panes)
            print(f"  window {window.window_index}:{window.window_name}: {ids}")
    window = right.window
    owner = window.session
    print(right.pane_id, "is in window", window.window_name,
          "of session", owner.session_name)
except Exception as error:
    raise RuntimeError("tmux quickstart failed") from error
finally:
    if socket.exists():
        server.kill()
    shutil.rmtree(directory)

require "libtmux"

# A private server: its own socket and an empty config, so this neither
# touches nor is changed by a tmux you already use.
server = LibTmux::Server.start

begin
  session = server.new_session(name: "demo", command: ["/bin/cat"])

  # Lay out the session: name its window, split it, add a second window.
  editor = server.window(session.snapshot.current_window.ref)
  editor.rename("editor")
  left = server.pane(editor.snapshot.active_pane.ref)
  right = left.split(direction: :horizontal, command: ["/bin/sh"])
  logs = session.new_window(name: "logs", command: ["/bin/cat"])

  # Type a command into the new pane and wait for what it prints.
  right.send_text("printf 'hello from %s\\n' tmux")
  right.send_keys("Enter")
  deadline = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) + 5
  until right.capture.stdout.include?("hello from tmux")
    if Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) > deadline
      raise "Output did not arrive within five seconds"
    end
    sleep 0.05
  end

  # Move the focus an attached client sees: the pane, then the window.
  right.select
  session.list_window_links.find { |link| link.window == logs }.select

  # Walk the objects: down from the server, then up from one pane.
  snapshot = server.snapshot
  snapshot.sessions.each do |entry|
    puts "session #{entry.name}"
    entry.window_links.each do |link|
      pane_ids = link.window.panes.map(&:id).join(" ")
      puts "  window #{link.index}:#{link.window.name}: #{pane_ids}"
    end
  end
  pane = snapshot.resolve(right.ref)
  window = pane.window
  owner = window.window_links.first.session
  puts "#{pane.id} is in window #{window.name} of session #{owner.name}"
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "tmux quickstart failed: #{error.message}"
  raise
ensure
  server.close
end

local adapter = require("libtmux.runtime.luv")
local uv = require("luv")

local function must(value, err)
    if err ~= nil then error(err, 0) end
    return value
end

local binary
for directory in (os.getenv("PATH") or ""):gmatch("[^:]+") do
    local candidate = uv.fs_realpath(directory .. "/tmux")
    if candidate and uv.fs_access(candidate, "X") then
        binary = candidate
        break
    end
end
assert(binary, "tmux must be installed on PATH")

-- A private server: a socket and an empty config of its own, so this
-- neither touches nor is changed by a tmux you already use.
local directory = assert(uv.fs_mkdtemp("/tmp/ltx-lua-home-XXXXXX"))
local socket = directory .. "/tmux.sock"

local function tmux(arguments)
    local args = { "-S", socket }
    for _, argument in ipairs(arguments) do
        args[#args + 1] = argument
    end

    local timer = assert(uv.new_timer())
    local process, status
    process = assert(uv.spawn(binary, {
        args = args,
        stdio = { nil, 1, 2 },
    }, function(code)
        status = code
        process:close()
        timer:stop()
        timer:close()
    end))
    timer:start(10000, 0, function()
        process:kill("sigkill")
    end)
    uv.run()
    assert(status == 0, "tmux command failed or timed out")
end

local ok, failure = xpcall(function()
    -- This Lua API connects to an existing daemon. Start our own first,
    -- and keep it alive with no session so the program creates them all.
    tmux({
        "-f", "/dev/null", "start-server", ";",
        "set-option", "-s", "exit-empty", "off",
    })

    must(adapter.run(function(runtime)
        local server = must(runtime:connect({
            binary = binary,
            socket_path = socket,
        }):await())
        local created = must(server:new_session({
            name = "demo",
        }):await())

        -- Lay out the session: name its window, split it, add a second
        -- window. None of them takes the focus from the first pane.
        local editor = created.window
        must(editor:rename("editor"):await())
        local split = must(created.pane:split({
            direction = "right",
        }):await())
        local right = split.pane
        local logs = must(created.session:new_window({
            name = "logs",
        }):await())

        -- Type a command into the new pane and wait for what it prints.
        local command = "printf 'hello from %s\\n' tmux"
        must(right:send_text(command):await())
        must(right:send_keys({ "Enter" }):await())
        must(right:wait_for_text("hello from tmux", {
            timeout = 10000,
        }):await())

        -- Move the focus an attached client sees: the pane, then the window.
        must(right:select():await())
        must(logs.window_link:select():await())

        -- Walk the objects: down from the server, then up from one pane.
        local snapshot = must(server:snapshot():await())
        for _, each in ipairs(snapshot.sessions) do
            print("session " .. each.name)
            for _, link in ipairs(each.window_links) do
                local window = link.window
                local line = ("  window %d:%s:"):format(
                    link.index, window.name
                )
                for _, pane in ipairs(window.panes) do
                    line = line .. " " .. pane.id
                end
                print(line)
            end
        end
        local id = right:reference().id
        for _, pane in ipairs(snapshot.panes) do
            if pane.id == id then
                local window = pane.window
                local owner = window.window_links[1].session
                print(("%s is in window %s of session %s"):format(
                    pane.id, window.name, owner.name
                ))
            end
        end

        must(server:close():await())
        return true
    end))
end, debug.traceback)

local cleaned, cleanup_error = pcall(function()
    if uv.fs_stat(socket) then tmux({ "kill-server" }) end
    local removed, _, code = uv.fs_unlink(socket)
    assert(removed or code == "ENOENT", "could not remove owned socket")
    assert(uv.fs_rmdir(directory))
end)

if not cleaned then io.stderr:write(tostring(cleanup_error), "\n") end
if not ok then error(failure, 0) end
assert(cleaned, "cleanup failed; retained " .. directory)

import io.github.libtmux.ServerConfig
import io.github.libtmux.ServerEndpoint
import io.github.libtmux.SplitSpec
import io.github.libtmux.TextOutcome
import io.github.libtmux.WindowSpec
import io.github.libtmux.kotlin.*
import java.nio.file.Path
import java.time.Duration
import java.util.UUID
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlin.time.Duration.Companion.seconds

fun main() = runBlocking {
    val socket = "libtmux-home-${UUID.randomUUID()}"
    val config = ServerConfig.builder()
        .endpoint(ServerEndpoint.namedSocket(socket))
        .configFile(Path.of("/dev/null"))
        .defaultTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(5))
        .build()

    withServer(config) { server ->
        val session = server.newSession("demo")

        // Lay out the session: name its window, split it,
        // add a second window.
        val first = session.activeWindow ?: error("no active window")
        val editor = first.rename("editor")
        val left = editor.activePane ?: error("no active pane")
        val side = SplitSpec.builder().toRight().detached().build()
        val right = left.split(side)
        val tab = WindowSpec.builder().named("logs").detached().build()
        val logs = session.newWindow(tab)

        // Type a command into the new pane and wait for what it prints.
        right.sendLine("printf 'hello from %s\\n' tmux")
        val outcome = right.awaitText(
            "hello from tmux", timeout = 5.seconds
        )
        check(outcome != TextOutcome.TIMED_OUT)

        // Move the focus an attached client sees:
        // the pane, then the window.
        right.select()
        logs.select()

        // Walk the objects: down from the server, then up from one pane.
        val sessions = server.sessions()
        for (each in sessions) {
            println("session ${each.name}")
            for (window in each.windows) {
                val ids = window.panes.joinToString(" ") { "${it.id}" }
                println("  window ${window.index}:${window.name}: $ids")
            }
        }

        val pane = server.pane(right.id) ?: error("no pane ${right.id}")
        val home = pane.window
        val owner = home.session
        println(
            "${pane.id} is in window ${home.name} of session ${owner.name}"
        )
    }
}

open System.Threading
open LibTmux
open LibTmux.FSharp

let runAsync () =
    task {
        use deadline = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds 30.)
        let token = deadline.Token

        let options =
            ServerConnectionOptions(
                SocketName = "fsharp-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"),
                ConfigurationFile = "/dev/null",
                TmuxBinaryPath =
                    (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable "LIBTMUX_TMUX"
                     |> Option.ofObj
                     |> Option.defaultValue "tmux")
            )

        use! owned = LibTmux.Server.CreateOwnedAsync(options, token)

        let! session =
            owned.Value.CreateSessionAsync(
                NewSessionRequest(Name = "demo", Command = "/bin/sh"),
                token
            )

        let! active =
            session
            |> Session.windows
            |> Query.where (WindowFields.active |> Filter.eq true)
            |> Query.list token

        let! editor = active[0] |> Window.rename token "editor"

        // Split its active pane; the new pane is on the right and stays
        // in the background, so the left pane is still active.
        let! left = editor |> Window.activePane token

        let! right =
            left
            |> Pane.split
                token
                (SplitPaneRequest(Direction = PaneDirection.Right))

        // A second window, also left in the background.
        let! logs =
            session |> Session.newWindow token (NewWindowRequest(Name = "logs"))

        // Type a command and wait for what it prints, not for its echo.
        let! waited =
            right
            |> Pane.sendAndWait
                token
                (TimeSpan.FromSeconds 10.)
                "printf 'hello from %s\\n' tmux"
                "hello from tmux"

        // Select the right pane, then the logs window.
        let! selected = right |> Pane.select token
        let! current = logs |> Window.select token

        // Walk a snapshot down from the server: sessions, windows, panes.
        let! server = LibTmux.Server.ConnectAsync(options, token)
        let! snapshot = server |> Server.capture token SnapshotDepth.Panes
        let sessions = snapshot.Sessions

        for session in sessions do
            printfn "session %s" session.Name
            let windows = session.Windows

            for window in windows do
                let panes = window.Panes
                let ids = [ for pane in panes -> string pane.Id ]

                printfn
                    "  window %d:%s: %s"
                    window.Index
                    window.Name
                    (String.Join(" ", ids))

        // Then up from one pane to its window and session.
        let pane = snapshot.Panes |> Seq.find (fun pane -> pane.Id = right.Id)
        let window = pane.Window
        let owner = window.Session

        printfn
            "%O is in window %s of session %s"
            pane.Id
            window.Name
            owner.Name
    }

    runAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult()
with error ->
    raise (InvalidOperationException(

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module "$PSScriptRoot/modules/LibTmux/0.1.0/LibTmux.psd1"

$session = $null
$failure = $null
try {
    # A private server: a socket and an empty config of its own, so this
    # neither touches nor is changed by a tmux you already use.
    # The process ID in the socket name keeps one run apart from the next.
    $socket = 'libtmux-home-' + $PID
    $server = New-TmuxServer -SocketName $socket -ConfigurationFile /dev/null
    $session = $server | New-TmuxSession -Name demo

    # Lay out the session: name its window, split it, add a second window.
    $window = $session | Get-TmuxWindow | Where-Object Active
    $editor = $window.RenameAsync('editor').GetAwaiter().GetResult()
    $left = $editor | Get-TmuxPane | Where-Object Active
    $right = $left | Split-TmuxPane -Horizontal
    $logs = $session | New-TmuxWindow -Name logs

    # Type a command into the new pane and wait for what it prints.
    $right | Send-TmuxText -Text "printf 'hello from %s\n' tmux" -Enter
    $found = $right | Wait-TmuxPaneText -Pattern 'hello from tmux' -Timeout 10
    if (-not $found.Found) { throw 'the pane never showed the output' }

    # Move the focus an attached client sees: the pane, then the window.
    $request = [LibTmux.SelectPaneRequest]::new()
    $right = $right.SelectAsync($request).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
    $logs = $logs.SelectAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult()

    # Walk the objects: down from the server, then up from one pane.
    $snapshot = $server | Get-TmuxSnapshot
    foreach ($each in $snapshot.Sessions) {
        "session $($each.Name)"
        foreach ($window in $each.Windows) {
            '  window {0}:{1}: {2}' -f

using LibTmux

try
    # A private server: a socket and an empty config of its own, so this
    # neither touches nor is changed by a tmux you already use.
    with_server() do server
        demo = new_session(server; name="demo")

        # Lay out the session: name its window, split it, add a second window.
        editor = only(windows(snapshot(server, demo))).ref
        rename_window(server, editor, "editor")
        left = only(filter(p -> p.active, panes(snapshot(server, editor)))).ref
        right = split_window(server, left; direction=:right)
        logs = new_window(server, demo; name="logs")

        # Type a command into the new pane and wait for what it prints.
        send_keys(server, right, "printf 'hello from %s\\n' tmux", "Enter")
        wait_for_text(server, right, "hello from tmux"; baseline=true)

        # Move the focus an attached client sees: the pane, then the window.
        select_pane(server, right)
        select_window(server, WindowLinkRef(demo, logs, 1))

        # Walk the objects: down from the server, then up from one pane.
        snap = snapshot(server)
        listed = sessions(snap)
        for each in listed
            println("session ", each.name)
            links = windowlinks(each)
            wins = [window(link) for link in links]
            for (link, win) in zip(links, wins)
                members = panes(win)
                ids = join((string(p.id) for p in members), " ")
                println("  window ", link.index, ":", win.name, ": ", ids)
            end
        end
        pane = snap[right]
        home = window(pane)
        owner = session(only(windowlinks(home)))
        println(string(pane.id), " is in window ", home.name,
                " of session ", owner.name)
    end
catch error
    println(stderr, "tmux quickstart failed: ", sprint(showerror, error))
    rethrow()
end

alias LibTmux.{Command, Pane, Ref, Selection, Server, Session, Snapshot, Window}

tmux = System.find_executable("tmux") || raise "tmux is not on PATH"
id = Base.encode16(:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(8), case: :lower)
dir = Path.join(System.tmp_dir!(), "libtmux-" <> id)
socket = Path.join(dir, "tmux.sock")
File.mkdir!(dir)
File.chmod!(dir, 0o700)

try do
  # libtmux works on a running server, so tmux itself starts the private one.
  create = ["new-session", "-d", "-s", "demo"]
  {_, 0} = System.cmd(tmux, ["-S", socket, "-f", "/dev/null" | create])
  server = Server.new(executable: tmux, socket: socket)

  # Lay out the session: name its window, split it, add a second window.
  snapshot = Server.snapshot!(server)
  session = snapshot |> Snapshot.sessions() |> Selection.one!()
  editor = Session.active_window(snapshot, session)
  {:ok, session_ref} = Ref.from_observation(session)
  {:ok, editor_ref} = Ref.from_observation(editor)
  Window.rename!(server, editor_ref, "editor")
  left =
    snapshot
    |> Snapshot.panes()
    |> Selection.one!(window_id: editor.id, active: true)
  {:ok, left_ref} = Ref.from_observation(left)
  %{id: right_id} = Pane.split!(server, left_ref, axis: :horizontal)
  %{id: logs_id} = Session.new_window!(server, session_ref, "logs")
  {:ok, right} = Ref.new(:pane, right_id, session.server_instance)

  # Type a command into the new pane and wait for what it prints.
  Pane.send_text!(server, right, "printf 'hello from %s\\n' tmux")
  Pane.send_keys!(server, right, ["Enter"])

  shown =
    Enum.find_value(1..250, fn _ ->
      screen = Pane.capture!(server, right)
      screen =~ "hello from tmux" || (Process.sleep(20) && nil)
    end)

  shown || raise "the pane did not print hello from tmux"

  # Move the focus an attached client sees: the pane, then the window.
  select_pane = Command.new("select-pane", ["-t", right_id])
  select_window = Command.new("select-window", ["-t", logs_id])
  {:ok, _} = Server.run(server, select_pane)
  {:ok, _} = Server.run(server, select_window)

  # Walk the objects: down from the server, then up from one pane.
  snapshot = Server.snapshot!(server)
  sessions = Snapshot.sessions(snapshot)

  for each <- sessions do
    IO.puts("session #{each.name}")
    links = Snapshot.related(snapshot, :session, each.id, :window_links)

    for link <- Enum.sort_by(links, & &1.index) do
      {:ok, window} = Snapshot.fetch(snapshot, :window, link.window_id)
      panes = Window.panes(snapshot, window)
      ids = Enum.map_join(panes, " ", & &1.id)
      IO.puts("  window #{link.index}:#{window.name}: #{ids}")
    end
  end

  pane = snapshot |> Snapshot.panes() |> Selection.one!(id: right_id)
  window = Snapshot.related(snapshot, :pane, pane.id, :window)
  [owner] = Snapshot.related(snapshot, :window, window.id, :sessions)
  IO.puts("#{pane.id} is in window #{window.name} of session #{owner.name}")
after
  System.cmd(tmux, ["-S", socket, "kill-server"], stderr_to_stdout: true)
  File.rm_rf(dir)
end

-- | Construct tmux domain values without starting a process
-- or contacting a server.
module Main (main) where

import LibTmux.Id (parseWindowId, renderWindowId)
import LibTmux.Value (dimensionValue, mkDimension)
import LibTmux.Version (parseVersion, renderVersion, requireSupported)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  version <- either (fail . show) pure $
    parseVersion "tmux 3.3\n" >>= requireSupported
  window <- either (fail . show) pure (parseWindowId "@17")
  width <- either (fail . show) pure (mkDimension 120)
  print (renderVersion version, renderWindowId window, dimensionValue width)

(require '[libtmux.core :as tm]
         '[libtmux.data :as data])
(import '[java.lang ProcessHandle]
        '[java.nio.file Files Path]
        '[java.nio.file.attribute FileAttribute]
        '[java.time Duration]
        [java.util.concurrent TimeUnit])

(let [attrs (make-array FileAttribute 0)
      root (Path/of "/tmp/libtmux-java-dev" (make-array String 0))
      _ (Files/createDirectories root attrs)
      directory (Files/createTempDirectory root "clojure-home-" attrs)
      socket (.resolve directory "tmux.sock")
      daemon (atom nil)]
  (try
    (with-open [server (tm/open! {:socket-path socket
                                 :binary (or (System/getenv "TMUX_BIN") "tmux")
                                 :config-file "/dev/null"})]
      (try
        (let [session (tm/new-session! server {:name "demo"
                                             :window-name "work"
                                             :command ["/bin/sh"]})
              window (data/exactly-one (data/windows session))
              pane (data/exactly-one (data/panes window))
              _ (reset! daemon
                        (.get (ProcessHandle/of
                               (get-in session [:tmux/identity :tmux/pid]))))]
          (tm/rename! (:tmux/ref window) "editor")
          (assert (= "work" (:window/name window)))
          (tm/split-pane! (:tmux/ref pane)
                          {:direction :right :command ["/bin/cat"]})
          (tm/new-window! (:tmux/ref session)
                          {:name "logs" :detached? true :command ["/bin/cat"]})
          (tm/send-literal! (:tmux/ref pane)
                            "printf 'hello from %s\\n' Clojure")
          (tm/send-keys! (:tmux/ref pane) ["Enter"])
          (assert (#{:appeared :present-at-entry}
                    (tm/await-text! (:tmux/ref pane) "hello from Clojure"
                                    (Duration/ofSeconds 2))))
          (let [snapshot (tm/snapshot! server)
                observed (data/exactly-one (:tmux/sessions snapshot))]
            (assert (= "demo" (:session/name observed)))
            (println "session" (:session/name observed))
            (doseq [entry (data/windows observed)]
              (println (str "  window " (:window/name entry) ": "
                            (count (data/panes entry)) " panes")))
            (assert (some #{"hello from Clojure"}
                          (tm/capture! (:tmux/ref pane))))
            (println "output=hello from Clojure")))
        (catch Exception failure
          (throw (ex-info "Clojure tmux quickstart failed"
                          {:tmux/failure (tm/error-summary failure)} failure)))
        (finally
          (tm/kill-server! server)
          (when-let [^ProcessHandle process @daemon]
            (.get (.onExit process) 1 TimeUnit/SECONDS)))))
    (finally
      (if-let [^ProcessHandle process @daemon]
        (when-not (.isAlive process)
          (Files/deleteIfExists socket)
          (Files/deleteIfExists directory))
        (when-not (Files/exists socket (make-array java.nio.file.LinkOption 0))
          (Files/deleteIfExists directory)))))
  (assert (not (Files/exists directory
                            (make-array java.nio.file.LinkOption 0)))))

(require :asdf)

(defparameter *source-root* (or (uiop:getenv "LIBTMUX_SOURCE") "."))
(defparameter *program* (or (uiop:getenv "LIBTMUX_PROGRAM") "tmux"))
(defparameter *socket-path*
  (or (uiop:getenv "LIBTMUX_EXAMPLE_SOCKET")
      (error "Set LIBTMUX_EXAMPLE_SOCKET to the owned tmux socket path")))

(asdf:load-asd
 (truename (merge-pathnames "libtmux.asd"
                            (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname *source-root*))))
(asdf:load-system "libtmux")

(defun observed-value (outcome)
  "Return OUTCOME's observed value, or signal its observation failure."
  (when (libtmux:outcome-observation-error outcome)
    (error (libtmux:outcome-observation-error outcome)))
  (multiple-value-bind (value present-p) (libtmux:outcome-value outcome)
    (unless present-p
      (error "The operation did not return an observation"))
    value))

(libtmux:with-client (client :program *program* :socket-path *socket-path*
                               :config-file "/dev/null")
    (let ((normal nil))
      (unwind-protect
           (multiple-value-prog1
               (let* ((before (libtmux:fetch-snapshot client))
                      (demo (find "demo" (libtmux:sessions before)
                                  :key #'libtmux:name :test #'string=))
                      (editor-link (aref (libtmux:window-links demo) 0))
                      (editor (libtmux:window editor-link))
                      (left (aref (libtmux:panes editor) 0))
                      (right (observed-value
                              (libtmux:split-pane
                               client left :direction :horizontal
                               :command '("/bin/cat"))))
                      (logs (observed-value
                             (libtmux:new-window
                              client demo :name "logs"
                              :command '("/bin/cat")))))
                 (declare (ignore logs))
                 (libtmux:send-text client right "hello from tmux" :enter t)
                 (multiple-value-bind (text outcome)
                     (libtmux:capture-pane client right)
                   (assert (eq :succeeded (libtmux:outcome-status outcome)))
                   (assert (search "hello from tmux" text)))
                 (let* ((snapshot (libtmux:fetch-snapshot client))
                        (pane (find (libtmux:id right)
                                    (libtmux:panes snapshot)
                                    :key #'libtmux:id :test #'string=))
                        (window (libtmux:window pane))
                        (owner-link (aref (libtmux:window-links window) 0))
                        (owner (libtmux:session owner-link)))
                   (loop for session across (libtmux:sessions snapshot)
                         do (format t "session ~A~%" (libtmux:name session))
                            (loop for link across
                                    (libtmux:window-links session)
                                  for each = (libtmux:window link)
                                  do (format t "  window ~D:~A:"
                                             (libtmux:index link)
                                             (libtmux:name each))
                                     (loop for item across
                                             (libtmux:panes each)
                                           do (format t " ~A"
                                                      (libtmux:id item)))
                                     (terpri)))
                   (format t "~A is in window ~A of session ~A~%"
                           (libtmux:id pane) (libtmux:name window)
                           (libtmux:name owner))))
             (setf normal t))
        (handler-case (libtmux:kill-server client)
          (error (condition)
            (if normal
                (error condition)
                (warn "Owned server cleanup also failed: ~A" condition)))))))

export LIBTMUX_SOURCE="$PWD/source"

  new-session -d -s demo -n editor -x 80 -y 24 -- /bin/cat

    (unless present-p
